question: Should OpenClaw expose restart-required model/provider/auth configuration drift as a supported `runtimeConfig` health payload after it is sourced from reloader-owned state?
rationale: The request-time I/O defect has a concrete repair, but accepting a durable health API and its sensitive-detail boundary requires gateway owner intent.

options.title: Expose Prepared Drift
options.body: Keep the diagnostic with reloader-owned convergence state, non-sensitive read output, and admin-only fingerprints or detailed errors.

options.title: Keep Existing Reload Signals
options.body: Decline the separate `runtimeConfig` block and rely on reload logs plus the existing `configReload.hotReloadStatus` field.

recommendation.title: Expose Prepared Drift
recommendation.body: Keep the diagnostic with reloader-owned convergence state, non-sensitive read output, and admin-only fingerprints or detailed errors.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the closest merged lifecycle-owned health contract and cached-response integration.
